title: The Calendars Are Set. The Conditions Are Not.
method: AI-assisted cross-source synthesis with direct links to originating publishers. Reviewed against a four-item gate including two primary government or institutional sources.

items.headline: Somalia sets April parliamentary and May presidential election dates
items.whyItMatters: A published timetable creates a measurable transition point, while opposition concerns and the security environment remain unresolved.

items.headline: Kenya seeks new multilateral budget financing before June 2027
items.whyItMatters: Concessional external funding could reduce domestic borrowing pressure, but the amount, terms and timing remain unsettled.

items.headline: United Kingdom urges de-escalation between Ethiopia and Eritrea
items.whyItMatters: The official statement adds diplomatic pressure but does not establish that the parties have accepted mediation or agreed to de-escalate.

items.headline: EAC adopts a ten-year regional tourism marketing strategy
items.whyItMatters: Common standards, cross-border packages and easier movement can create a regional tourism product, but implementation remains national and incomplete.
